description:
Client: Bank Of America. 

 Pega CSSA positions 

 Location: Plano, TX (2 positions) and Charlotte, NC(1 position). 

 Duration: Full time with Synechron. 

 Job Description 

         * Senior System Architect (CSSA) Pega Certification a MUST. 
         * Total 6 - 10 years in information technologies with 5+ years of 
 experience in analysis, design, development, deployment of large scale 
 Java centric enterprise application systems. 
         * Experience on Pega PRPC v6.x, v7.x and Frameworks. 
         * Strong knowledge on Pega Upgrades, Integration and all Pega Tools. 
         * Monitor, troubleshoot and repair infrastructure, application, 
 operating systems and/or hardware and/or network issues. 
         * Able to guide leadership on technology architecture issues. 
         * Promote the development of technical infrastructure/architecture and 
 standards to enable delivery to business domains. 
         * Ability to negotiate and allocate resources appropriately for 
 development and implementation. 

         *  Experience in the Financial Services Industry a plus. 
         * Hands on Design/Development experience in Pega Case Management 
 required. 
         * Pega organizational routing process. 
         * Application Security concepts. 
         * Integration (ex. REST) and their error handing. 
         * Custom CSS and UI components. 




 
 Highlights and benefits 
 
 We are a registered E verified company 
 Starting salary between $ 60,000 with regular increments 
 Free classroom skill enhancement program 
 Relocation allowance 
 Referral bonus 
 On the job support from experienced professionals in the relative field 
 Travel allowance 
 Insurance- Medical, dental, vision and 401K 
 Health Benefits through Carefirst BCBS (Blue Cross Blue Shield) 
 Company paid Life Insurance 
 
 Please respond with your resume. US Citizens and all other parties authorized to work in the US are encouraged to apply. 
 

 Job Type: Contract
 Salary: $60,000.00 /year
 Required education:
 Bachelor's
 Required experience:
 Developer: 5-12year
